description: Just minutes from the beach, Amapola House Ocean View Villa is a four level beach area vacation rental home with a plunge pool, nature deck and a sky deck in Rincon, Puerto Rico near the best beachfront bars & restaurants.The spacePuerto Rico’s Amapola House is a private getaway minutes from the quaint town of Rincon, nestled near sweeping hillsides and tropical scenery in the Caribbean islands. Located a few minutes away from pristine Sandy Beach and the best Rincon restaurants and bars, Amapola House provides a comfortable resting place for those that want to have an activity-filled day, but a quiet place to return to at night. The owners make sure that Amapola House feels more like second home than a hotel. Built by the Avilés family, who has lived in the area for generations, the house features modern design and stylish décor. Named after the hibiscus flowers that used to bloom on the property of the family matriarch, Amelia Avilés, Amapola House features photos and sepias of Old Rincon going back to the 1890’s. The current owners Purchased the home from the Avilés family in June of 2018.Once situated, guests can sit in comfortable chairs and look out into the tropical scenery from the Starlight Veranda, the private suite terrace or the roof top deck. They can also sunbathe on the Sun Deck, which is perfect for relaxing evenings and offers a plunge pool, bar, and bathroom.Amapola House is a four-level vacation home with four bedrooms. All the bedrooms include large closets and either a queen bed or two twin beds. With three full bathrooms, the house comfortably accommodates up to eight people. Rooms are decorated in rich yellow and terracotta tones in a contemporary style. A private suite is located on its own level with a private terrace and outdoor dining area. Guests who like to cook on holiday will love the fully equipped kitchen and cocktail bar. Amapola House also offers a dining service for eight, and several great restaurants are minutes away.Amapola House offers a unique vacation experience that vastly differs from others in the area. Located in a private area that is only reachable through nearly untraveled roads, it gives guests seclusion and tranquility, while still being close to the area’s best beaches and hotspots. The art, antiques and photos offer a glimpse into Rincon’s past and the history of surfing. Guests will truly feel at home at Amapola House, which was designed to do just that. The golden sands and pristine waters of Sandy Beach are only two minutes by car and ten minutes on foot. Our Sun Deck sunsets are unforgettable and the nights are filled with millions of stars and bright moonlight.The interior is designer-decorated and contains a private collection of heirloom antiques and vintage photographs of Old Rincon and Surfing legends, which are part of The Amapola House Story.Everyone that stays at Amapola House only regrets not staying longer and wishes to return soon, as indicated in our Guest Book entries.Our kitchen and bar are well-equipped. Guest sleeps quite comfortably in beds with high-quality mattresses and high-count linens (no futons or pull outs). Extra large closets keep your living accommodations spacious. Our oversized towels are plush and so are our beach towels. The large bathrooms offer rain shower heads, glass basins and oversized mirrors to allow you to pamper yourself as you prepare for the evening, after a day at the beach or a day trip. iPod stereos, DVD players, flat screen TV's and full cable TV service provide entertainment between outings. High-speed wireless Internet keeps you connected when you want to be. The wifi in the area, however, can be unreliable at times and guests should consider this before arriving. Our caretaker is nearby and available to assist you during your stay at Amapola House and to ensure that your stay is a comfortable one. To reserve your stay or for more about Amapola House, go to Reservations or call us.Guests have exclusive to The rooftop Sun Deck which has deck chairs, pool, bar, and awesome nature and ocean views. A BBQ Grill, wine cooler, split system A/C's flat screen TV, wireless internet and cable service are available for your enjoyment. Please keep in mind the wireless internet in the area is not always working perfectly and can affect access. We are located on a quiet and breezy hillside, minutes from the best beaches, restaurants and beach bars.Rental rates already include a 7% government room tax.Guest accessGuests have exclusive to all Levels. Nature Deck is covered from the rain. The rooftop Sun Deck has, deck chairs and awesome nature and ocean views. A BBQ Grill, iPod stereos, split system A/C's flat screen TV, plunge pool, wireless internet (area wifi can become unreliable at times) and TV service are available for your enjoyment. This home has four levels with stairs and may not be suitable for wheelchairs and the elderly.Other things to note*****FIVE STAR REVIEWS- We are the proud new owners of the Amapola House. This property has been a Five Star vacation rental in Rincon since 2008. Our Family has been vacationing in Rincon at least twice a year for the last twelve years. We rented the Amapola House twice over the last five years. When we heard it was on the Market, be it only for 5 days. We flew down and bought it. The previous owner was a Super Host on AirBnB. Amapola House is one of the highest rated properties in Rincon. We will happily provide copies of the previous reviews by email.Note: Rental rates already include a 7% government room tax.

title: Happiness 1 - Cute 1 BR w/2 beds at Sandy Beach
description: Happiness By the Beach is located in the heart of Puntas, Rincon PR. We are right across the street from the beautiful Sandy beach, breathtaking beach views, restaurants, mini market, surfboard rentals, beach front yoga classes and more. At our place you'll enjoy beautiful, elegant, modern and comfortable lodgings with access to a beautiful patio with a relaxing pool with sun loungers for sunbathing, grill area, and luxurious lounge area patio furniture under an opulent pergola. Stay, BE HAPPY!The spaceHappiness By the Beach is an exclusive, beautiful, modern, recently renovated building with 2 apartments and two studios on the first floor. The second floor has two beautiful apartments with independent entrances. The main entrance leads to a beautiful patio with an opulent pergola, underneath which there is an exquisite lounging area with luxurious outdoor patio furniture and an awesome grill area. in the patio you'll also find beautifully relaxing pool, a gorgeous mural by local artist, Albert Padilla, and sun loungers for sunbathing. The entrances to Units 1-3 are on the right side of the patio with glass doors and windows to let in the light and to appreciate the view of the patio from the inside. Hotel-like black out curtains are installed for the guest to use should you desire privacyUnit 1 is a comfortable, elegant studio full of art, equipped with two full beds suited for 4 guests, bathroom, kitchen, small table with stools for 4 and TV. Unit 1 features include: 2 full sized beds, bed and bath linens, smart flat screen TV with cable, complimentary secured wireless internet, private bathroom, microwave oven, fridge, coffee maker, stove top, shampoo and conditioner, body wash, and beach towels. The enclosed property includes a beautiful pool, sun loungers, luxury patio furniture, gas and coal grills (BBQ) and outdoor shower. The whole building is equipped with an automatic generator to protect your vacation investment from common island power outages.Guest accessAt the property, guest have access to pool, outdoor shower, gas and coal grill (BBQ), sun loungers and outdoor patio lounge.The neighborhood in very walkable, but we recommend you have a car to go downtown, visit other beaches and other parts of the island and to do grocery shopping.There is free onsite parking at the property and on the street.Other things to noteWhile we provide internet service, generator in case of very common power outages and water in case water goes out as well, we do ask that you are conscious that these are not fail proof. We have a regular maintenance schedule to keep our premises and our services in the best conditions possible. If any of these were to fail during your stay rest assured, we will do everything in our power to resolve the issue in a timely manner, also taking into consideration the maintenance personnel and technician’s availability and abilities.
